qe: If first half and second half both are written in the reverse order respectively then which letter will be 10th to the left of 9th from the right end?
qh: यदि प्रथम अर्द्धांश और द्वितीय अर्द्धांश दोनों को क्रमशः उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो दाएँ छोर से 9वें अक्षर के बाएँ 10वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Two Halves Reverse Shortcut Trick):
Step 1: Series structure samjhein:
- First half (A se M) reversed: $M, L, K, \dots, B, A$ (1 se 13 tak).
- Second half (N se Z) reversed: $Z, Y, X, \dots, O, N$ (14 se 26 tak).
Step 2: Effective position from Right end nikalte hain (Right + Left):
$$\text{Position from Right} = 9 + 10 = 19\text{th letter}$$
Step 3: Daayein (Right) se aane par pehle 13 letters second half ($N \to Z$) ke aayenge. Bachenge:
$$19 - 13 = 6\text{th letter from first half (A ki taraf se)}$$
- First half me 'A' boundary par hai ($A, B, C, D, E, F$), isliye 'A' se 6th letter 'F' hoga.
Correct option  F hai.

Method 2 (Left-End Conversion Method):
- Total letters = 26. Position from Left end $= (26 + 1) - 19 = 8$th from Left.
- First half me Left se shuruat 'M' (13) se hoti hai, isliye baayein se 8th letter: $14 - 8 = 6$th letter of alphabet = 'F'.
Sahi uttar 'F' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If first half and second half both are written in the reverse order respectively then which letter will be 8th to the left of 15th from the right end?
qh: यदि प्रथम अर्द्धांश और द्वितीय अर्द्धांश दोनों को क्रमशः उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो दाएँ छोर से 15वें अक्षर के बाएँ 8वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Boundary Crossing Shortcut Trick):
Step 1: Position from Right end nikalte hain (Right + Left):
$$\text{Position from Right} = 15 + 8 = 23\text{rd letter}$$
Step 2: Second half ke 13 letters cross karne ke baad:
$$23 - 13 = 10\text{th letter into first half from 'A'}$$
Step 3: First half me 'A' se shuru karte hue 10वाँ letter 'J' hota hai.
Correct option  J hai.

Method 2 (Left-End Offset Method):
- Left se position $= (26 + 1) - 23 = 4$th from Left.
- Baayein se 4th letter 'M' se counting me: $M(1), L(2), K(3), J(4)$.
Sahi uttar 'J' hai.

qe: If first half and second half both are written in the reverse order respectively then which letter will be 6th to the right of 15th from the right end?

e:
Method 1 (Second-Half Direct Offset Trick):
Step 1: Samaan disha (Right aur Right) hone par ghataate hain:
$$\text{Position from Right} = 15 - 6 = 9\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: Chuki $9 \le 13$, yeh letter second half ($Z \to N$) me hi sthit hai.
Step 3: Second half me daayein (Right) end par 'N' (14th) hai, isliye 'N' se 9 kadam aage:
$$\text{Original Position} = 13 + 9 = 22$$
Alphabet me 22वाँ letter 'V' hota hai.
Correct option  V hai.

Method 2 (Sequential Forward Counting from N):
Second half daayein se: $N(1), O(2), P(3), Q(4), R(5), S(6), T(7), U(8), V(9)$.
9th letter 'V' prapt hota hai.
Sahi uttar 'V' hai.

e:

$$\text{Position from Right} = 14 - 11 = 3\text{rd letter}$$
Step 2: $3 \le 13$ hone se yeh second half me hai jahan Right end par 'N' hai:
$$\text{Original Position} = 13 + 3 = 16$$
16वाँ letter 'P' hota hai.
Correct option  P hai.

Method 2 (Right-End Direct Counting Method):
Second half daayein chhor se shuru hota hai: $N(1), O(2), P(3)$.
3rd position par aane wala letter 'P' hai.

e:

$$\text{Position from Left} = 11 + 8 = 19\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: Pehle 13 letters first half ($M \to A$) cross karne ke baad second half ($Z \to N$) me pravesh karein:

Alphabet me 21वाँ letter 'U' hota hai.

Second half $Z$ se shuru hota hai: $Z(1), Y(2), X(3), W(4), V(5), U(6)$.

Step 2: Second half me 'Z' ki taraf se sthiti nikalein:
$$23 - 13 = 10\text{th letter from 'Z'}$$

$$\text{Original Position} = 27 - 10 = 17$$

- Second half daayein se 'N' se start hota hai: $N(1), O(2), P(3), Q(4)$.

e:

Alphabet me 10वाँ letter 'J' hota hai.

First half: $M(1), L(2), K(3), J(4)$.
